_note: Addendum 1 to the v4 preregistration (OSF s5m9t): generalisation checks of H1 across attackers (A) and of H2 across attributes and cohorts (B). Read by scripts/addendum_reattack.py (--confirm), addendum_a_summarise.py, addendum_b_e2.py (--confirm) and addendum_b_summarise.py. Directions = those predicted in v4 (K2 > K0, D0 > D2; lambda1 > lambda0 for GB2). Consistent unit: A = one-sided sign-flip permutation p of K2 - K0 <= alpha, complete, no H1 condition (K2, K0) over 10% missing; B primary = lower bound of the 95% interval > 0 and estimate > delta_E2; B secondary = lower bound > 0. Supported = at least m of 3. The registered text (docs/preregistration-addendum-1-en.md) is authoritative.

A.think_note: Passed as --think to scripts/addendum_reattack.py; the output file is attack_<model>_think-<value>.jsonl. true is the value v4's E1 passes. magistral:24b produced no thinking under structured output in the dry run (a non-reasoning attacker).
A.decision: one-sided sign-flip permutation p of K2 - K0 (v4's H1 statistic) <= alpha, unadjusted; complete; neither K2 nor K0 (lambda 1, D0) over 10% missing reads or unusable persons
A.inclusion_rule: (1) fits a Colab L4, accepts think, returns the structured JSON probability within num_predict 4096 for all probe reads; (2) within a K its output depends on the release (not the same value for every read); (3) reasoning models first; if fewer than 3 pass, a model of another developer passing (1) and (2) is added and marked non-reasoning.
A.run_order_note: Run one attacker at a time in this order (the most expensive first); no read p is summarised or looked at until all three are finished or stopped.

B.consistent_primary: lower bound of the 95% interval > 0 and estimate > delta_E2 (0.005)
